interpretation: incident_uid uniquely identifies the experimental unit
no incident_uid may appear in more than one partition
partition CSV rows must match frozen manifest
possible real-world duplicate incidents are diagnostic only
timestamps parse, start precedes end, duration matches
very short and long incidents are retained but flagged
missing ASN reduces BGP feature anchoring confidence
prefix may be absent for outage labels
same ASN across partitions is diagnostic, not automatic leakage
same or related prefixes across partitions are diagnostic
simultaneous events can be independent or related
partition duration/year/country/ASN/prefix distributions are comparable enough for pre-MRT stage
